notes:
Profile: mid-market helpdesk platform with 3rd-party customers; heavy Zendesk footprint (triggers, macros). Primary ask = accurate ticket/email summaries + deterministic auto-tagging for routing into specialist queues. POC scope: 6-week pilot, 50k avg monthly tickets, 6-8k spike days.

Key technical constraints: must support Zendesk/Freshdesk macros, produce structured tags (product, priority, language), and allow a fallback rule when inference latency > 700ms (prefer server-side retry/circuit-breaker).

POC results so far: summaries reduce mean handle-time estimates by ~18% in internal sim, auto-tagging precision 84% (needs 92% for full rollout). Latency profile:  p95 ~1800ms under concurrent worker counts used in test — SE recommends quantized model variant + batching for p95 reduction.

Security/compliance notes: customer needs SSO (Okta) + audit logs forwarded to their SIEM, optional HSM-backed KMS. Legal asked for explicit data deletion SLA for EU tenants.

Quotes & shorthand from calls: "If you can nail tags we can auto-route 30% of tickets off human queue" — Head of Ops. "We need a consistent rollback plan when models misclassify priority" — CS Director.
